name: Watch a flood rise
desc:
Exploiting ruins the experience for both you and other players!
Using exploits will result in a ban with no appeal!

Inspired by: Watch a black hole grow (it is no longer playable)
Some tools may not work on console, sorry for the inconvenience!

Most of the badges in the game will also give you a special item.
You may need to check the Backpack to see all of your tools (` key on PC)

Getting pushed around too much? Try turning off Forced Movement and/or Player Collision in the settings.
If you get teleported to a new server, the game probably updated.
